status: retrospective protocol freeze before final reported model collection
scope: Hydrogen-station process physics and SAGA-PY decision-support validation

process_physics.dataset: Powertech Labs SAE J2601 Tables Method laboratory data
process_physics.tank_submodel_split: laboratory test number modulo 3 equals 0 is validation; all other eligible tests are calibration
process_physics.experimental_quality_screen: 0.8 <= integrated measured mass / nominal SOC-implied mass change <= 1.2
process_physics.quality_screen_sensitivity: repeat the calibration with all 36 tests retained
secondary_endpoints: final SOC error in percentage points
process_physics.uncertainty: case-level nonparametric percentile bootstrap of each mean, 10000 replicates
process_physics.closed_loop_role: uncalibrated diagnostic baseline; controller and dispenser claims require acceptable external agreement

decision_support.dataset: JRC HIAD 2.2 HRS events with a response, lesson, or corrective field
decision_support.split: deterministic consequence-stratified 25 percent development / 75 percent holdout split using SHA-256 ordering
decision_support.holdout_access: freeze and approve leakage-reviewed vignettes before collecting model responses
decision_support.sampling: three SAGA responses per event under a frozen provider/model configuration
decision_support.primary_endpoint: paired event-level difference in mean seven-criterion expert composite score
decision_support.reviewers: at least two independent qualified hydrogen/process-safety reviewers, blinded to allocation
decision_support.inference: case-level bootstrap 95 percent CI and paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test

consequence_physics.dataset: USN/FFI open-ended rectangular-channel hydrogen dispersion experiments
consequence_physics.status: normalization complete; no direct production-model validation claim before explicit release and sensor geometry mapping
consequence_physics.prohibited_claim: channel measurements alone validate outdoor station consequence distances

claim_rule: Unit tests demonstrate implementation consistency only. Physical, decision-support, field-safety, and regulatory claims require their stated external evidence.
